attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: pdf_article_extraction_via_ai_vision
steps:
  - id: authenticate_drive_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "drive_service_account"
    output: auth_result

  - id: search_drive_for_pdfs
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/google-drive/search"
      query:
        folder: "pending_articles"
        mime_type: "application/pdf"
    output: raw_pdf_list

  - id: filter_pending_pdfs
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_list
      condition: "status == 'pending'"
    output: pending_pdfs

  - id: loop_each_pdf
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: pending_pdfs
      step: process_single_pdf
    output: all_extracted_articles

  - id: process_single_pdf
    op: call_subworkflow
    params:
      workflow_id: process_single_pdf_subworkflow
    output: single_pdf_result

  - id: validate_extracted_articles
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: all_extracted_articles
      schema:
        required_fields:
          - title
          - section
          - content
        rules:
          - field: lead
            condition: "not_empty"
          - field: es_multiple
            condition: "boolean_optional"
    output: validated_articles

  - id: check_format_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "if es_multiple == true then format = 'multiple_book_reviews' else format = 'single_article'"
      input: validated_articles
    output: format_decision

  - id: route_by_format
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "format_decision.format == 'multiple_book_reviews'"
      true_step: transform_multiple_reviews
      false_step: transform_single_article

  - id: transform_multiple_reviews
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_articles
      mapping:
        replace_double_quotes: "replace('\"', \"'\")"
        structure: "flatten_book_reviews"
        ensure_lead_not_empty: true
    output: transformed_reviews

  - id: transform_single_article
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_articles
      mapping:
        replace_double_quotes: "replace('\"', \"'\")"
        structure: "single_article_map"
        fields:
          - title
          - author
          - section
          - lead
          - body
          - highlighted_quotes
          - sidebars
        ensure_lead_not_empty: true
    output: transformed_article

  - id: merge_transformed
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input_a: transformed_reviews
      input_b: transformed_article
      key: "article_id"
      strategy: "coalesce"
    output: merged_articles

  - id: write_articles_to_db
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: merged_articles
      table: "extracted_articles"
    output: write_result

  - id: log_extraction_audit
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: merged_articles
      action: "pdf_article_extraction_completed"
      details:
        source: "google_drive_pending_articles"
        record_count: "merged_articles.length"
    output: audit_log_entry

  - id: notify_editor
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: merged_articles
      recipient: "editor@economicsmagazine.com"
      subject: "New articles extracted from PDF"
      message: "Article extraction complete. Articles are ready for review."
    output: notification_result

  - id: handle_extraction_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error_in:
        - search_drive_for_pdfs
        - loop_each_pdf
        - validate_extracted_articles
      route_to: notify_error

  - id: notify_error
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: auth_result
      recipient: "admin@economicsmagazine.com"
      subject: "PDF Extraction Workflow Error"
      message: "An error occurred during the PDF article extraction workflow."
    output: error_notification_result

  - id: terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      message: "PDF article extraction workflow finished successfully."
